description:
Read and write cookies of a Chromium (CDP) app, HttpOnly cookies included.
`set` needs `name`, `value`, and `url` or `domain`; `delete` needs `name` and `url` or `domain`.
Use when seeding an authenticated session before an e2e test (set the session cookie, then navigate) or asserting cookie state after one.
Returns { cookies, count } for get, or a small status object ({ set } / { deleted } / { cleared }) otherwise. Fails if the device is not a Chromium (CDP) device, or a param that `set` / `delete` needs is missing.

action.description: get: read cookies. set: create/update a cookie. delete: remove matching cookies. clear: remove ALL browser cookies.

domain.description: set/delete: scope the cookie by domain.

expires.description: set: expiry as a Unix timestamp (seconds). Omit for a session cookie.

url.description: get: restrict to this URL (defaults to the active page). set/delete: scope the cookie by URL.

name: chromium-cookies
